sv.title: C-kvinnor: Nej till borgerlig regering
sv.summary: Centern kan inte göra sig beroende av SD. Det menar Centerkvinnorna. Partiet borde gå i opposition i stället för att ingå i en borgerlig regering, skriver de på Expressen debatt.

en.title: C-women: No to bourgeois government
en.summary: The Centre Party cannot make itself dependent on the Sweden Democrats. That is the view of the Centre Party Women's League. The party should go into opposition rather than join a bourgeois government, they write in an Expressen debate piece.
